Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Killeen for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 20 (Nature In Lights at Fort Hood) through January 3, 2027, with Letters to Santa (through December 4), the Tree Lighting Festival (December 4), The Santa Switch musical (December 4 to 13), the Christmas Parade (December 12) and The Nutcracker (December 17 to 20) along the way. New in this update: The Santa Switch, The Nutcracker and Sugar Plum Tea at Central Texas Theatre, and the Home Depot Holiday Train Kids Workshop (December 5). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
